newsitem.title: UK: UK machine tools turnover rises in 3mths to March.
newsitem.headline: UK machine tools turnover rises in 3mths to March.

text.p: The Office for National Statistics said turnover of machine tools in Britain the first quarter of 1997 rose by 0.2 percent compared with the previous quarter.
This was due to a 14.7 percent rise in export turnover which more than offset a 8.0 percent decrease in home turnover.
Compared with the same period a year ago, total turnover increased by 2.1 percent.
Total orders on hand for machine tools at the end of March were down 14.4 percent fall compared with the level at the end of December, and a 9.3 percent fall compared with March 1996.
